definitions.gloss: short story, short piece, short film
definitions.explanation: A literary work or film that is shorter than a full-length novel or feature film.

examples.japanese: {短編|たんぺん}⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いている→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I am writing a short story.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{短編|たんぺん}⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I like this director's short films.

examples.japanese: {短編|たんぺん}⟦{集|しゅう}→集：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦{終|お}えた→終える：02019_oeru⟧。
examples.english: I finished reading the short story collection.

notes:
{短編|たんぺん} refers to short-form works in literature, film, or other media.

WORD FORMATION:
⟦{短|たん}→短〜：03959_tan⟧ (short) + ⟦{編|ぺん}→〜編：28472_hen⟧ (piece/volume)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {短編|たんぺん}⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧ (short story)
- {短編|たんぺん}⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧ (short film)
- {短編|たんぺん}⟦{集|しゅう}→集：noentry⟧ (short story collection / anthology)
- {短編|たんぺん}⟦アニメ→アニメ：01527_anime⟧ (short animated film)

LENGTH SCALE:
- {短編|たんぺん}: short piece
- ⟦{中編|ちゅうへん}→中編：19271_chuuhen⟧: medium-length work (novella)
- ⟦{長編|ちょうへん}→長編：14475_chouhen⟧: long piece, full-length work (novel, feature film)

USAGE:
Can be used as a standalone noun or as a modifier. {短編|たんぺん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名手|めいしゅ}→名手：28527_meishu⟧ means "a master of short stories."
